chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim Majilawayh narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Sayrafi, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said in a long narration, in which he says at its end:

Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Umm Salama (may Allah be pleased with her): O Umm Salama, hear and testify: This is Ali ibn Abi Talib, my brother in this world and my brother in the Hereafter. O Umm Salama, hear and testify: This is Ali ibn Abi Talib, my minister in this world and my minister in the Hereafter. O Umm Salama, hear and testify: This is Ali ibn Abi Talib, the carrier of my banner in this world and the carrier of the Banner of Praise tomorrow in the Hereafter. O Umm Salama, hear and testify: This is Ali ibn Abi Talib, my Bequeathed and Successor after me, the one who completes my count and defends my Basin. O Umm Salama, hear and testify: This is Ali ibn Abi Talib, the Master of the Muslims, the Leader of the God-fearing, the Chief of the White-footed, the killer of the Violators, the Heretics, and the Equivocators.

I said: O Messenger of Allah, who are the Violators? He said: Those who pledge allegiance to him in Medina and violate it in Basra. I said: Who are the Equivocators? He said: Mu'awiya and his companions from the people of the Levant. [Then] I said: Who are the Heretics? He said: The people of Nahrawan.

key_terms.الغر المحجلين: The White-footed (referring to those marked by wudu)
key_terms.المارقون: The Heretics/Renegades (those who exited the fold)
key_terms.الناكثون: The Violators (those who broke their oath/pledge)
key_terms.حوضي: My Basin (referring to the Prophet's Hawd)

ai.seo_question: Who are the Nakisun, Qasitun, and Mariqun according to this hadith from Ma'ani al-Akhbar?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Mani al-Akhbar* establishes Ali ibn Abi Talib’s (as) comprehensive authority through the Prophet’s (saww) declaration to Umm Salama, linking his spiritual role as 'carrier of the banner of praise' with his political role as the leader who confronts specific dissenters. It provides the definitive Shia exegesis for the tripartite classification of early Islamic opposition: the 'Violators' (Nakithun) as Aisha’s faction in Basra, the 'Equivocators' (Qasitun) as Mu'awiya and the Umayyads, and the 'Heretics' (Mariqun) as the Khawarij of Nahrawan. This classification is central to Shia historiography in distinguishing between those who broke their oath, those who deviated in judgment, and those who exited the fold of Islam.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Abi’l-Qasim Majilawayh, from Muhammed bin Ali al-Sayrafi, from Muhammed bin Sinan, from Mufaddal bin Umar, that he said: Abu Abdillah (a.s.) said in a long narration in which he says in its ending:

Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (saww), said to Umm Salama (saww): O Umm Salama, hear and testify: This is Ali bin Abi Talib, my brother in this world and my brother in the Hereafter. O Umm Salama, hear and testify: This is Ali bin Abi Talib, my minister in this world and my minister in the Hereafter. O Umm Salama, hear and testify: This is Ali bin Abi Talib, the carrier of my banner in this world and the carrier of the banner of praise tomorrow in the Hereafter. O Umm Salama, hear and testify: This is Ali bin Abi Talib, my Bequeathed and Successor after me, the defeater of my enemies and protector of my basin. O Umm Salama, hear and testify: This is Ali bin Abi Talib, the Master of the Muslims, the Leader of the Godfearing, the Chief of the White-footed, the killer of the violators, the heretics and the renegades.

I said: O Messenger of Allah, who are the violators? He said: Those who will pledge allegiance to him in Medina and violate it in Basra. I said: Who are the heretics? He said: Mu’awiya and his companions from the people of the Levant. Then I said: Who are the renegades? He said: The people of Nahrawan.
